ziegler-daniel: Joseph Ziegler, ed., Susanna, Daniel, Bel et Draco, Septuaginta: Vetus Testamentum Graecum 16/2 (Göttingen, 1954; 2nd ed. by Olivier Munnich, 1999)
ulrich-djd16: Eugene Ulrich and others, Qumran Cave 4.XI: Psalms to Chronicles, Discoveries in the Judaean Desert 16 (Oxford, 2000), which publishes the Daniel scrolls from Cave 4
ware-inner-kingdom: Kallistos Ware, "Dare We Hope for the Salvation of All? Origen, St Gregory of Nyssa and St Isaac the Syrian," in The Inner Kingdom (2000)
justin-epitome: Justin (Marcus Junianus Justinus), Epitome of the Philippic Histories of Pompeius Trogus, book 27, on the Third Syrian War (the epitome is Roman; Trogus wrote in the first century BC)
polybius-raphia: Polybius, Histories (second century BC), book 5, sections 79-86, on the battle of Raphia (217 BC) and the size of the two armies
nicene-creed-381: The Nicene-Constantinopolitan Creed (AD 381), as received by the Council of Chalcedon (451)
belgic-confession-art12: The Belgic Confession (1561), article 12, on the creation of all things, including the angels
oca-synaxis-michael: Orthodox Church in America, Lives of the Saints and liturgical texts for 8 November: the Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers (oca.org)
